calls.title: Book a meeting with Nestor (Christian Liebenow)
calls.summary: The meeting discussed strategies for expanding GrowthBook within Aircall, transitioning its use from primarily experimentation to full feature flagging across all teams. Led by Nestor Pina, the Engineering Director, the conversation highlighted the current involvement of about 13 teams using GrowthBook for experiments and the need for a scalable feature flagging solution. Nestor emphasized the importance of evaluating GrowthBook’s pricing plans, as well as enterprise features like SSO and audit logs. The need for an improved system became evident due to limitations of the existing manual feature flagging processes. The meeting underscored the significance of enterprise features for governance and security, with discussions on deployment models (self-hosted vs SaaS) and a planned demo to showcase GrowthBook’s comprehensive capabilities.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, feature flagging, experimentation, enterprise plan, self-hosted, SaaS

calls.title: 30 min with Karen (Christian Liebenow)
calls.summary:
# 30 min with Karen (Christian Liebenow)
Date: 2026-08-31 | Duration: 25.510000228881836m

## Summary
The discussion focused on improving GrowthBook’s sales process and helping prospects evaluate its value more easily. Christian Liebenow proposed a customizable Notion guide combining pricing, roadmap information, product philosophy, competitive positioning, customer stories, support details, and security resources. The group identified pricing confusion between the $480/year Pro option and $200k+ enterprise fees as a major friction point. Prospects typically compare GrowthBook with homegrown tools, EPO, Statsig, and open-source or Pro alternatives, and they usually want technical demonstrations. An updated 5–10 minute demo was identified as the main content gap, while existing videos, PDFs, and technical resources are underused. Customer stories, support quotes, product releases, API improvements, and trust-center links could strengthen differentiation. High-end dinners and podcasts have generated stronger opportunities than cold LinkedIn outreach, while email and social response rates remain low.

## Keywords
Pricing model, technical demos, customer stories, outbound engagement, enterprise vs Pro, Notion content

## Action Items

**Christian Liebenow**
Prepare a detailed, customizable Notion page template to help prospects evaluate GrowthBook, including competitive positioning, pricing philosophy, roadmap, and anonymized customer stories (03:31)
Include specific content on enterprise vs Pro plan distinctions and support benefits in sales materials (15:33)
Utilize new or updated demo video content in prospect follow-ups once available (20:11)
Continue to leverage high-value outbound engagement tactics such as dinners and podcast appearances (20:58)

**Karen Henke**
Support creation and integration of a Notion-based sales evaluation page and explore use of Notion AI for personalized content delivery (06:27)
Assist in collecting anonymized customer testimonials and positioning statements for inclusion in sales collateral (12:13)
Coordinate the launch and communication of the new product updates area to help re-engage cold prospects (16:39)
